analysisType: Retrospective descriptive comparison; no trajectories generated

definitions.alignment: Sort by tick or interval endpoint, then numeric seed. Include accepted historical prefix through 3000; only ticks 3001-6000 are continuation evidence.
definitions.population: tickRows.population each executed tick; tick zero from samples[0].census.population
definitions.family_counts_and_families: samples.census.familyCounts in family index order mint/gold/lilac, slash-separated
definitions.band_occupancy: Count saved frame.cells entries whose linear tile index modulo 96 is 0..23 or 48..71 inclusive. Occupied body tiles, not body counts.
definitions.food_remaining: Sum decoded unsigned bytes of frames.foodBase64; whole-world food stock.
definitions.window_population: Minimum, arithmetic mean, maximum and final population over inclusive from..to (500 executed ticks).
definitions.accepted_and_overflow: Difference of cumulative samples.environment.accepted/overflow at interval endpoints. Each interval offers 76800; accepted is deposition, not uptake.
definitions.missing_values: Empty CSV fields are unsampled. Family, occupancy and food are saved every 20 ticks. No interpolation.
definitions.repeat: Independently initialized exact repeats verify reproducibility, not additional independent samples.
definitions.recommendations: Future metrics are recommendations only; frozen conclusions and stopping rules unchanged.

validation: Every CSV field recomputed from immutable committed JSON; sample/frame census and state digest identities, family counts, all 26 snapshot food/occupancy endpoints, existing six-tail-window summaries, source artifact SHA256 bindings, and zero cap48/positive births/deaths in each continuation window checked. No model import or stepping.
